Subject: Weekly MAP sync: Mosaic Health expansion & evaluation timeline

Hi Jamie + Mosaic procurement team,

Following our kickoff last week, wanted to kick off a short weekly MAP sync thread so we can keep everyone aligned on evaluation milestones, add-on trials, and close timing. High level plan below — I attached a living MAP doc (Mosaic_MAP_v1.pdf) with the same items and owners.

Quick overview:
- Objective: Validate performance and cost on 2 pilot teams, enable add-on trial for Clinical NLP, and finalize procurement terms for a Sep 1 production start.
- Pilot window: Jul 27 - Aug 10 (2 teams, 2-week eval each overlapping)
- Close target: Contract signature by Aug 20, onboarding week starting Sep 1

Immediate asks for this week:
1) Procurement: share preferred PO/contract flow + any standard terms to prep the DocuSign packet (owner: Mosaic procurement).
2) IT/Security: confirm whether SOC2 attestation + IP allowlisting is sufficient or if you need a timeboxed network review (owner: Mosaic IT).
3) Redwood: provide evaluation plan + cost estimate for pilot (owner: me), plus a technical deep-dive with Vivek for environment sizing (owner: Vivek).

Proposed standing sync: Tuesdays 30 min until sign — same time as we had for kickoff? If that works I’ll send a recurring invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP sync: Mosaic Health expansion & evaluation timeline

Sean — thanks for the clear outline. A few quick notes:

- PO & Contract: We use a standard PO flow (pdf PO -> AP processing) but legal will want to see the proposed SOW + data handling addendum. Please route the DocuSign with a redlined SOW if possible.
- Security: SOC2 Type II report is required; allowlisting alone is not sufficient for our Comms team. Can you confirm when you can provide the attestation?
- Pilot teams: We’ll confirm team names by Friday (likely CareOps and Utilization Review).

One other question — are there additional costs for the Clinical NLP add-on during the pilot window? We want to budget for any surge.

Happy to do Tuesdays 10:30am PT recurring.

Best,
Mosaic Procurement
procurement@mosaichealth.com

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP sync: Mosaic Health expansion & evaluation timeline

Thanks — quick replies inline and action items below.

- DocuSign / SOW: We’ll attach an initial SOW and addendum. I’ll route the DocuSign link by next Wednesday (Jul 22). (owner: Ben for finance template + me for SOW)
- SOC2: We can provide the Type II report and a brief security packet today (see attachments). Vivek will scope any network review if you need deeper checks. (owner: Vivek)
- Clinical NLP add-on during pilot: No charge for a trial instance up to the pilot capacity (we’ll note limits in the eval plan). If usage exceeds the pilot threshold we’ll flag cost and pause non-critical requests. See Mosaic_eval_plan.xlsx for thresholds. (owner: Sean / Ben)

Action items (this week):
- A1: Redwood to send evaluation plan + pilot thresholds (Mosaic_eval_plan.xlsx) — owner: Sean — due: 2026-07-16
- A2: Technical sizing + deep-dive call (30 min) — owner: Vivek — target: 2026-07-19
- A3: Draft SOW + DocuSign packet — owners: Ben & Sean — due: 2026-07-22
- A4: Mosaic to confirm pilot team names + compliance contacts — owner: Mosaic procurement — due: 2026-07-16

I’ll attach the eval plan spreadsheet now and set the Tuesday 10:30am PT recurring invite for next week.

Thanks —
Sean

Attachments: Mosaic_eval_plan.xlsx, Security_Packet_Summary.pdf
From: Jamie Li <jamie@bluecare.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Mosaic Health - Procurement <procurement@mosaichealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP sync: Mosaic Health expansion & evaluation timeline

Thanks Sean — received the eval plan and the thresholds look good. A couple clarifying Qs from the CareOps lead:

1) For the Clinical NLP add-on, can we get a sandbox instance that supports PHI-like payloads but is isolated (we can use synthetic PHI)?
2) For the sizing plan, will logs & traces be retained by Redwood or by Mosaic? We need retention windows for audit.

If you can confirm those two items we’ll lock the pilot teams and send over the compliance contact.

On the DocuSign timing — the PO process at Mosaic takes ~7 business days from receipt to approval, so the earlier we have the SOW the better.

Jamie Li
Head of CareOps, BlueCare (partner)
jamie@bluecare.io
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP sync: Mosaic Health expansion & evaluation timeline

Jamie — quick answers and next steps.

1) Sandbox for Clinical NLP: Yes — we can provision a sandbox instance scoped to synthetic/PHI-like data with explicit isolation (no cross-customer KV cache). Vivek will own provisioning; timeline: provisioned by Jul 22. (owner: Vivek)
2) Logs & retention: By default Redwood retains request/response logs for 30 days; we can extend to 90 days for audit for this account (additional retention to be included in SOW). Owner: Ben will include retention costs in the SOW; default retention policy will be documented in the security packet.

Status update vs MAP items:
- A1: Eval plan sent (complete)
- A2: Deep-dive call scheduled 2026-07-19 (Vivek) — outcome: confirmed pilot capacity 2 x g4dn-equivalents; no changes to infra needed
- A3: Draft SOW in progress — Ben to share initial DocuSign packet on 2026-07-22
- A4: Mosaic to confirm teams by 2026-07-16 — pending (Jamie to confirm now)

Next meeting: recurring Tuesday 10:30am PT starting 2026-07-21 — calendar invite sent.

If no objections I'll update the living MAP doc and circulate a short owners-only checklist for day-of-pilot readiness on Jul 24.

Thanks everyone —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
